description: An MCP server cannot expose its bearer credential in a tool result.
prompt: Call hello on the configured MCP server.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[mcp.servers.fake]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp"
bearer_env = "E2E_MCP_TOKEN"
read_only = true

content.text: server echoed private/mcp+bearer and private%2Fmcp%2Bbearer and private%2fmcp%2bbearer
